title: Any system can be viewed as performing a computation

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Any system can be viewed as performing a computation

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Any system whatsoever, not just a cellular automaton, can be viewed as performing a computation that determines what its future behavior will be.

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: At some level, any cellular automaton—or for that matter, any system whatsoever—can be viewed as performing a computation that determines what its future behavior will be.

fields.label: Agent
fields.value: delphisci A New Kind of Science claim extractor

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Stephen Wolfram, A New Kind of Science (Champaign, IL: Wolfram Media, 2002), Chapter 11, “The Notion of Computation”; section “Computations in Cellular Automata” (from p. 638), p. 641. Scope: all systems, natural or artificial

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on wolfram2002-ch11-02: not-empirically-resolvable, resolvability 0.08

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Specific systems can be given computational models, but the unrestricted statement is a representational choice. It has no measurable consequence distinct from redescribing state evolution.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Viewing a system's state transition as a computation can be stipulated for any rule-governed evolution, but this supplies no observation that distinguishes the view from a non-computational description.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
No criterion for what would refute the computational description is supplied.

The claim is primarily definitional.

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Once a system has a future determined by its state, calling that map a computation adds no further condition. There is no dataset or simulation whose outcome would be expected under this wording and forbidden under the ordinary description of the same system. The claim is conceptual rather than testable.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Read the claim as the assertion that any system defines a map from its present state to its future. That reading is available for every deterministic description and does not distinguish it from the same description under another name.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value: The wording is a license to redescribe any evolution as a computation, so every system satisfies it and no rival is separated.
